question: Which organizations are Tier 1 validators on Stellar right now, and where can I check the current set myself?

golden.answer: As of 2026-11-14 the Tier 1 set was ten organizations, each running three validators: SDF, Blockdaemon, Franklin Templeton, LOBSTR, Public Node, Creit Technologies, OBSRVR, Figure (YLDS), MoneyGram, and Range. Obsrvr Radar shows the live validator set and network quorum set; SDF's example Mainnet validator configuration lists the same organizations. Check a live view, because the set changes.
keyFacts: Names the Tier 1 organizations as of a stated date.
Obsrvr Radar publishes the live validator set and network quorum set.
SDF is one of the Tier 1 organizations.
avoid: Do NOT name SatoshiPay as a current Tier 1 organization; it left the set in 2026.
golden.notes: Grade the roster against a live quorum-set view and accept a later dated roster that differs. The set changed twice in 2026: OBSRVR replaced SatoshiPay, then MoneyGram, Figure and Range joined. A roster that matches the pre-2026 set and carries no date is stale, not current.

truth.notes: Roster is live. The complete roster is not on developers.stellar.org; the Tier 1 page links to Obsrvr Radar. Radar's API field quorumSetConfiguration is stale (six organizations, SatoshiPay included) and must not be used as the roster.

corroboration.claim: On 2026-11-14 the Tier 1 set was ten organizations with three validators each: SDF, Blockdaemon, Franklin Templeton, LOBSTR, Public Node, Creit Technologies, OBSRVR, Figure (YLDS), MoneyGram, Range.

evidence.note: transitiveQuorumSet holds 30 public keys; grouped by organization: Figure Certificate Company, Public Node, Creit Technologies LLP, LOBSTR, Range, MoneyGram, Franklin Templeton, OBSRVR, Stellar Development Foundation, Blockdaemon Inc., 3 each.

Ten HOME_DOMAINS entries at HIGH quality: publicnode.org, lobstr.co, www.franklintempleton.com, stellar.withobsrvr.com, stellar.creit.tech, www.stellar.org, stellar.blockdaemon.com, www.ylds.com, moneygram.com, stellar.validator.range.org.
SDF announced that MoneyGram, Figure Markets, and Range will operate Tier 1 validators; integration into the quorum configuration expected by mid-August.

corroboration.claim: Obsrvr Radar is the public live view of validators and the network quorum set that the official Tier 1 page points to.

evidence.note: Resources table: "Obsrvr Radar — public validator uptime and quorum monitoring"; candidates must show uptime "visible on Obsrvr Radar".
The API returns nodes, organizations, each node's quorumSet, and the computed transitiveQuorumSet with a scan time.

corroboration.claim: SDF runs three Tier 1 validators (SDF 1, SDF 2, SDF 3).

evidence.note: Nodes SDF 1, SDF 2 and SDF 3 (home domain www.stellar.org) are in the transitive quorum set.

corroboration.claim: SatoshiPay was a current Tier 1 organization on 2026-11-14.

evidence.note: 2026-07-14 commit: "Replace SatoshiPay with OBSRVR in pubnet full validator example (#223)".

No satoshipay.io node is in the transitive quorum set or in SDF 1's quorum set. Radar's own static quorumSetConfiguration field still lists SatoshiPay; that field is the scanner's configuration, not the live network set.

evidence: Sibling sweep: q-protocol-tier1-requirements tests the joining requirements and names no roster; q-protocol-validator-node-roles and q-protocol-quorum-slice-vs-quorum name no organizations. No conflict.
